entities.summary: Sim Sang-jung (b. 1959-02-20, Paju) was a civil rights leader or advocate of the Contemporary era, characterized by technology, globalization, and rapid social change, active in Paju and South Korea. Known in the fields of south korea, labor organizers, asia.
